request.description: Removes the document: it is marked `deleted`, its file is erased from storage, and checklists stop counting it. Documents already sent to a lender are locked (409 `DOCUMENT_LOCKED`). Borrower and partner contexts. Borrowers see the documents of their own borrower profiles and applications; staff see them by role (ops and compliance can also download; support sees metadata only). Others get 404.
